pet_notes: Preserve Blade as a compact SD/chibi adult swordsman: long layered navy-blue hair with wine-red tips and a long rear tail, amber-red eyes partly veiled by bangs, one long red earring, a black long coat with ornate bronze-gold chest panel and dark blue patterns, pale gray trousers, red lining and accents, white bandages on the right hand and left upper arm, black gloves and boots. Keep his stern exhausted expression and quiet lethal presence. Include his dark red-black sword only when the animation action naturally benefits from it; the sword must remain attached to his hand or body, never floating. Preserve asymmetric costume details instead of mirror substitution.
style_notes: High-quality anime SD/chibi sprite illustration, crisp dark outlines, refined cel shading, compact proportions, readable silhouette at 192x208, restrained expression, no text or scenery.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `sticker`: Polished sticker mascot with bold clean shapes, crisp outline, flat colors, and minimal highlight detail.
